author: John Hammond
description:
This ClickFix technique stages the next payload through the browser cache, leaving a batch script on the file system before the user runs a command through the Windows Run dialog.

I take a closer look at how the payload is retrieved and examine the website's network traffic, including requests that contain the browser's user agent.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/oJHOlNTH7lY?si=8LruOkxZlfvFLII-
title: Browser Cache Payloads
